titulo: xAI’s last-minute scramble to stop Minnesota’s anti-nudification app law
cuerpo: xAI is suing Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison over a law passed back in May that broadly targets "nudification" apps, claiming that the statute's punitive provisions leave the company with "no practical choice but to restrict Grok Imagine's image-editing features in various ways."
